clips.title: The story
paras: Battleworn Axes are crude, notch-scarred weapons carried by the Blackrock orcs invading the Redridge Mountains. Marshal Marris accepts these recovered blades in Lakeshire as physical proof of dead invaders threatening the local populace.

These heavy, nicked axes serve as standard gear for the Blackrock reavers pushing south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge. For Marshal Marris and the beleaguered town watch of Lakeshire, collecting them serves two purposes: ensuring another marauding orc has fallen, and gathering physical evidence of how heavily armed the encroaching warband truly is.

Blackrock invaders have fortified Stonewatch Keep and established footholds in the southeastern pockets of Redridge, effectively trapping townspeople within Lakeshire. Stripping the raiders of their battleworn weapons directly diminishes the arms available to the warband while clearing the roads for Alliance travel.
